performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real; Google at $813 zero-conversion is a confirmed leak.

findings.text: SOW milestone overdue: Stripe Products QA marked done July 20 but no verified completion event exists — cash-path integrity unconfirmed.
Google Ads spent $813.24 over 28 days and produced 0 conversions — confirmed dead spend; pixel/conversion action is broken or absent.

Meta CPL improved -21.1% 7d vs prior 7d; 3-day signal (Aug 23-25: 8 leads, ~$185 spend) holds vs prior 3 days (Aug 20-22: 27 leads, ~$366 spend) — volume dipped on weekend zero-spend days; weekday efficiency confirmed.
GHL shows 131 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — leads arriving but pipeline stalls at intake, not an ads problem.
Google spend pulled back -28.72% 7d vs prior 7d, trending to ~$6-20/day from a $150+ peak — budget exhaustion or campaign pause, not a bid issue.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and pixel — $813.24 spent, 0 conversions; pause Google until tracking is verified.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has consumed $813.24 over 28 days with zero recorded conversions, and the 7-day spend is already pulling back -28.72%. The immediate action is to audit the conversion action setup in Google Ads and confirm the pixel is firing on the thank-you/call page — if no fix can be confirmed within 5 business days, pause Google Ads spend entirely to stop the leak. Success check: at least one conversion recorded in Google Ads within 3 days of the fix going live. Re-verify by 2026-08-31.

suggestions.text: Run Becklar dummy deactivation and BWS duplicate-order test — 0 won opps in GHL confirms cash-path verification is still open.
suggestions.monday_update: The Stripe Products QA milestone (July 20) has no verified completion event, and GHL shows 131 opportunities created with 0 won and 0 appointments — suggesting intake or activation flows may not be closing correctly. The action is to run one dummy Becklar deactivation and one live order through each intake path (WordPress/Stripe and GHL Products) to confirm single-opportunity creation with full field mapping. Success is confirmed when both tests pass with no duplicate opps and the Becklar portal reflects the deactivation. Complete by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +15% on BWS Call Campaign Retarget — CPL down -21.1%, 152 leads at $15.94 CPL confirmed efficient.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 152 leads at a 28-day CPL of $15.94 with a -21.1% CPL improvement week-over-week, and the BWS - July - Call Campaign - Retarget is the top campaign at $542 spend. Raise the daily budget on this campaign by +15% (from current level). Success check: CPL remains at or below $15.94 and lead volume grows within 7 days. Re-check 2026-09-02 before any further scaling.
